key.name: icon-size
key.summary: App icon size in pixels

key.name: zoom
key.summary: Magnification of the hovered icon, 1 turns it off

key.name: margin
key.summary: Gap between the bar and the screen edge in pixels

key.name: opacity
key.summary: Background opacity in percent

key.name: radius
key.summary: Corner radius in pixels

key.name: shadow
key.summary: A soft shadow under the bar, and under the top bar in the dock's look

key.name: highlight-active
key.summary: A soft tile behind the icon of the app in front

key.name: blur
key.summary: Blur the wallpaper behind the bar, windows under it are not blurred

key.name: blur-radius
key.summary: Blur strength in pixels

key.name: animation
key.summary: Hover animation of the app icons

key.name: bounce
key.summary: Bounce the icon while an app starts

key.name: pop
key.summary: Apps pop in and out, their neighbours make room

key.name: squash
key.summary: Squash an icon briefly when it is clicked

key.name: glide
key.summary: Window dots glide to their new size

key.name: intro
key.summary: Icons rise in a wave when the bar appears (login, unlock)

key.name: badge-pop
key.summary: Badges pop up when their number changes

key.name: minimize-to-icon
key.summary: Windows minimize into their icon and come back out of it

key.name: poof
key.summary: An app dragged off the dock goes up in a little cloud

key.name: springy
key.summary: The bar springs back in after autohide

key.name: lift-buttons
key.summary: Top bar buttons in the dock lift on hover instead of lighting up

key.name: warp
key.summary: The ArcMenu button in the dock takes off like a rocket

key.name: position
key.summary: Screen edge the bar sits on

key.name: all-monitors
key.summary: A dock on every monitor, the top bar content stays on the primary one

key.name: keep-top-bar
key.summary: With the bar at the bottom, keep GNOME's top bar at the top

key.name: style-top-bar
key.summary: Give GNOME's top bar the dock's look where it stays on its own (bar on the left or right, or kept)

key.name: colors
key.summary: Colors of the bar: its own, from the themes (background and transparency from the shell theme's top bar, the accent from the GTK theme, else the system accent), or the color below with a border in a shade of it

key.name: color
key.summary: Background color as a CSS color, used when colors is custom

key.name: tint-icons
key.summary: Show the icons in the row in one tone of icon-color

key.name: icon-color
key.summary: Tint of the icons as a CSS color, used with tint-icons

key.name: separators
key.summary: Separators between favorites, running apps and the top bar content

key.name: dynamic-opacity
key.summary: Make the background opaque while a window touches the bar

key.name: attention
key.summary: Wiggle the icon of an app that asks for attention

key.name: tooltips
key.summary: Show the app name above the hovered icon

key.name: badges
key.summary: Show counts and progress that apps publish on their icons

key.name: notification-badges
key.summary: Apps without their own count get the number of their notifications as a badge

key.name: trash
key.summary: Show the trash after the apps

key.name: drives
key.summary: Show removable drives after the apps

key.name: internal-drives
key.summary: Also show internal drives (open only, no unmount from the dock)

key.name: previews
key.summary: Show thumbnails of an app's windows when hovering its icon

key.name: peek
key.summary: While the pointer rests on a window preview, only that window stays visible

key.name: click-previews
key.summary: A click on an app with several windows shows their previews instead of cycling them

key.name: media
key.summary: Title and play, pause, next in the right click menu of apps that play media (MPRIS)

key.name: scroll-workspaces
key.summary: Scrolling on a free spot of the bar switches workspaces

key.name: scroll
key.summary: Scrolling over an app icon switches between the app's windows

key.name: dnd
key.summary: Drag icons to rearrange favorites, drop apps to pin them, drag them off to unpin

key.name: autohide
key.summary: Hide the bar while a window overlaps it, show it again at the screen edge

key.name: edge-pressure
key.summary: A hidden bar only comes back when the pointer pushes against the screen edge, not when it passes by
